description: This file defines the interface `AsyncLoanCOBExecutorService` with a single method for executing a loan COB catch-up process asynchronously within the Fineract project.

classes.name: AsyncLoanCOBExecutorService
classes.description: Interface for asynchronously executing Loan Close of Business (COB) catch-up operations.

methods.name: executeLoanCOBCatchUpAsync
methods.description: Initiates the asynchronous execution of COB catch-up for a loan, using the provided Fineract context.
